title: A Killer's Mistake
description: Natalie and Paul had a seemingly idyllic relationship; the investigation uncovers a dark reality of control and violence after her disappearance.

description: Alex Rodda, a 15-year-old teenager, is murdered by 18-year-old Matthew Mason in December 2019, six weeks after they first exchange messages via social media.

description: Exploring the death of a Canadian Mormon teenager Ashley Wadsworth due to social media grooming by British teenager Jack Sepple, leading to a fatal outcome during their planned meeting.

title: Murder suspect

description: Toronto's Gay Village is plagued by a serial killer who evades police and disposes of victims in plain sight.

description: A thorough look into the disappearance of men from Toronto's Gay Village continues.

title: Murder on the Fringe
description: Transgender sex worker, Moka Dawkins, is attacked by a client and fights him off; when police arrive, it's Moka that's arrested and put on trial for murder.

title: Murder on the Fringe
description: The gripping true-crime story of transgender sex worker, Moka Dawkins, and her fight for justice continues.

title: Murder on the Fringe
description: Gay porn's biggest star, Brent Corrigan, finds himself tangled up in the brutal murder of Bryan Kocis, owner of the Cobra Video porn empire.

description: Desperate to prove his innocence, Brent Corrigan entices the real killers in this bizarre tale of jealousy, greed and murder in the world of gay porn.

title: Murder Detective
description: Sharon Birchwood was killed at her home in the sleepy village of Ashtead, Surrey; she was found by her ex-husband, strangled to death and trussed up in parcel tape.

description: Jody Dobrowski was just 24 when he was brutally murdered in an attack so cruel, he could only be identified through fingerprints; his attackers were motivated by homophobic thuggery and planned an attack based solely on sexuality.

title: Murder Detective
description: Graham Hill examines how Irish dance champion Adrian Murphy fell victim to the fatal intentions of Diana Cristea and her boyfriend Joel Osei.

title: Murder Detective
description: Maheswaran Kaneshan sought asylum in the UK, but became caught up in a gang feud that turned deadly; his life was controlled by the gang that had brought him to London; gang bosses brutally beat Maheswaran, causing him to later die in hospital.

title: Murder Detective
description: Dean Mayley had learning difficulties and was taking steps in becoming an independent adult; on his way home he encountered a group of men who taunted him and beat him to death.

title: Made for Murder
description: A man bails his love interest out of debt, but pays the ultimate price with his life; his killer's lifelong narcissistic tendencies might have been a warning sign.

title: Made for Murder
description: When a pensioner dies following a blaze in a Cornish care home, it soon emerges that care worker Karen Pedley has a history of strange connections to arson attacks dating back years.

title: Made for Murder
description: Malcolm Webster murdered his first wife and attempted to do the same to his second, in a greed-fuelled frenzy; experts discuss whether he was always destined to become a callous murderer.

title: Made for Murder
description: As a teenager, Stephen Hough lied and manipulated his way out of facing justice for a horrific crime; it took forty years for detectives to bring him to justice, when they discovered that his evil deeds had continued long into adulthood.

title: Made for Murder
description: Thomas Dunkley hero-worships boxer Shaun Cummins; when an accident leaves the fighter paralyzed, he seizes the chance to become his right-hand man; however, nobody could have guessed that he would go on to become his killer.

description: Marcel investigates the killing of Eve Stratford, a Bunny Girl who worked at London's Playboy nightclub and examines its links to another unsolved murder.

description: The investigation takes an unexpected turn as modern technology reveals a new victim; Marcel learns that detectives are flying out to Asia; a predator is uncovered.

description: Ex-detective Colin Sutton revisits the case of The Camden Ripper, a serial killer sentenced to life for three murders but who may have taken more lives before his arrest in 2003.
